description: Source code implementing a WGL (Windows Graphics Library) surface for offscreen rendering (pbuffer) in ANGLE, including creation, destruction, binding, and querying of pbuffer resources.

classes.name: rx::PbufferSurfaceWGL
classes.description: Class managing an offscreen WGL pbuffer surface, including creation, destruction, and binding operations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the pbuffer surface, creating the pbuffer and obtaining its device context.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the buffer (no-op).

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the pbuffer as a texture image.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the pbuffer from being a texture image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the pbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the pbuffer.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Indicates if post sub-buffer is supported (returns false).

methods.name: getDC
methods.description: Returns the device context handle for the pbuffer.
